0022600143.text: The Clippers (1-2, 9th in the West) host the Lakers (3-1, 1st in the Pacific), with Los Angeles holding a 1-0 road record and a 1-0 home record for the Clippers, who are 0-2 on the road, and the Lakers having lost their most recent game. Los Angeles leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0, while the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26, and the Clippers last met the Lakers on October 23, 2026, in Los Angeles, losing 125-117. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), Rui Hachimura (quadriceps soreness), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while the Lakers are without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation), Cameron Carr (oblique strain), Luka Doncic (back), and Ziaire Williams (foot).
